subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should the agents runtime accept the custom cooperative glob walker and between-handler yielding as the permanent bootstrap behavior, including their ordering and wall-clock tradeoffs?
rationale: Tests and proof support the responsiveness improvement, but automated review cannot choose whether the compatibility and session-timing deltas are acceptable product/runtime policy.

options.title: Rebase and land
options.body: Accept the responsiveness tradeoff, rebase onto current main, and require exact-head parity, session-ordering, SDK-surface, and benchmark validation before merge.

options.title: Narrow the patch
options.body: Keep asynchronous root reads and diagnostics but defer either the custom glob walker or hook-handler yielding until its compatibility boundary is reviewed separately.

options.title: Pause for runtime redesign
options.body: Close or pause this branch if maintainers prefer a shared scheduling or worker-isolation design rather than owning a bootstrap-specific walker and dispatch mode.

recommendation.title: Rebase and land
recommendation.body: Accept the responsiveness tradeoff, rebase onto current main, and require exact-head parity, session-ordering, SDK-surface, and benchmark validation before merge.
